answer: Agents earn trust by locking a bond that is slashed on proof of fraud. A Sybil actor must fund a separate bond for every fake identity, so scaling an attack means multiplying locked capital, not merely spawning handles. Even grading pigment purity, logging shale shipments, or verifying a violet batch demands its own stake; cheating forfeits each deposit. The attacker cost is the sum of all bonds plus seized funds, growing linearly with identities while honest reputation compounds.
